  - main:
    - text: CLASS 12 · DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS
    - heading "Homogeneous First-Order Equations" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Ratio-substitution lab for dy/dx = (x+y)/x = 1 + y/x.
    - text: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT calculus
    - heading "♙ RATIO-SUBSTITUTION LAB" [level=3]
    - article:
      - 'heading "❶ Geometry: slope depends only on v = y/x" [level=3]'
      - paragraph: dy/dx = 1 + y/x = 1 + v is constant along each ray from the origin.
      - complementary:
        - text: Drag point P
        - strong: P(4, 2)
        - separator
        - text: v = y/x
        - strong: "0.5"
        - separator
        - text: Slope
        - strong: "1.5"
        - paragraph: Move P along the same ray. Slope stays the same.
        - button "Reset point":
          - img
          - text: Reset point
      - checkbox "Show slope value" [checked]
      - text: Show slope value
      - img "Ratio invariant ray graph": P (4, 2) v = tan θ = y/x = 0.5 Slope = 1 + v = 1.5
      - slider "Point along ray": "1"
      - paragraph: "Key fact: All points on the same ray (same v) give the same slope 1+v."
    - article:
      - heading "❷ Ratio substitution & solve" [level=3]
      - text: 1 Substitute
      - paragraph: y = vx
      - text: Let v=y/x. Then y=vx. 2 Differentiate (product rule)
      - paragraph: dy/dx = v + x dv/dx
      - text: 3 Substitute into the equation
      - paragraph: v + x dv/dx = 1 + v
      - text: 4 Simplify
      - paragraph: dv/dx = 1/x
      - text: 5 Integrate
      - paragraph: v = ln|x| + C
      - text: 6 Back-substitute v=y/x
      - paragraph: y = x ln|x| + Cx
      - strong: "General solution: y = x ln|x| + Cx, x ≠ 0"
    - article:
      - heading "❸ Scale test (homogeneity test)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: F(x,y) = (x+y)/x
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "(x,y) F(x,y) (tx,ty) F(tx,ty) Equal?":
            - columnheader "(x,y)"
            - columnheader "F(x,y)"
            - columnheader "(tx,ty)"
            - columnheader "F(tx,ty)"
            - columnheader "Equal?"
        - rowgroup:
          - row "(3,1) 4/3 (6,2) 4/3 ✓":
            - cell "(3,1)"
            - cell "4/3"
            - cell "(6,2)"
            - cell "4/3"
            - cell "✓"
          - row "(2,−1) 1/2 (6,−3) 1/2 ✓":
            - cell "(2,−1)"
            - cell "1/2"
            - cell "(6,−3)"
            - cell "1/2"
            - cell "✓"
          - row "(−4,2) 1/2 (−8,4) 1/2 ✓":
            - cell "(−4,2)"
            - cell "1/2"
            - cell "(−8,4)"
            - cell "1/2"
            - cell "✓"
      - paragraph: Since F(tx,ty)=F(x,y) for all t≠0, the equation is homogeneous of degree 0.
    - article:
      - heading "❹ Slope field & solution family" [level=3]
      - img
      - text: C = -2 C = -1 C = 0 C = 1 C = 2
      - paragraph: "Domain: x ≠ 0. Solutions exist on each interval (−∞,0) and (0,∞)."
    - article:
      - heading "❺ Domain & caution" [level=3]
      - text: "Domain: x ≠ 0 ⚠ Do not confuse!"
      - paragraph: This is NOT a homogeneous linear equation of the form dy/dx+P(x)y=Q(x).
      - paragraph: It is homogeneous first-order because F(x,y) depends only on y/x and satisfies F(tx,ty)=F(x,y).
